name: Key Management
description: Register, revoke, and list API keys with encrypted storage. Supports single and dual credentials, XOR-encrypted transport, and quota tracking integration.
description_cn: 注册、撤销和列出 API 密钥，支持加密存储、单双凭据、XOR 加密传输和配额追踪集成。

directives.usage_cn: 密钥;注册,<服务名>,<值1>[,<值2>],<密钥类型>
directives.description: Register a service key with encrypted local storage. Supports single and dual credentials.
directives.description_cn: 注册服务密钥，支持单凭据和双凭据模式。密钥加密存储。

directives.description: Remove a registered key from local storage.
directives.description_cn: 从本地存储中移除已注册的密钥。

directives.description: List all registered keys (values not exposed).
directives.description_cn: 列出所有已注册的密钥（不暴露密钥值）。

directives.usage_cn: 密钥;配额追踪,<服务名>[,<目标1>,<目标2>,...]
directives.description: Set or clear quota tracking targets for a service key.
directives.description_cn: 为服务密钥设置或清除配额追踪目标。

directives.description: Read plaintext from key_registry, XOR-encrypt, and return hex cipher. For secure credential injection into external systems.
directives.description_cn: 从密钥库读取明文，XOR 加密后返回 hex 密文。用于向外部系统安全注入凭据。
